label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
output:
Good day Mr Kehinde Ogunleye,

I am the student who lost the black Jansport bag in the danfo from Oshodi to Igando on Friday evening, 6 November. First, I want to thank you sincerely. Many people would have thrown the bag away or ignored it, but you took the trouble to call me. God will reward you for it.

I am a first-year Biology student. The bag has my lab manual, dissecting kit, student ID, two textbooks, calculator and glasses. My BIO 101 practical is on Wednesday 11 November at 10am, and without the kit and ID I will not be allowed into the lab. That is why I am writing to settle this properly.

About the 40,000 naira you mentioned on our last call, I have to be honest with you: I cannot pay that. I live on a small student allowance, and even the whole bag with everything inside does not come to that amount. What I can do is give you 10,000 naira, which is all my allowance, for your transport and as a thank-you for your kindness. I am offering it sincerely, and I hope you will see it as fair.

I would like us to meet in the daytime at Ikotun roundabout, or at the Ikotun police division gate, whichever is easier for you. Both are busy and easy to find. My roommate Adaeze will come with me.

Please tell me which day before Wednesday, and what time, suits you, and I will be there. A reply today will help me a lot because of my practical.

Thank you once again, sir. I look forward to hearing from you.

Regards,
[Your name]

---

One thing to check: the date I have is already Wednesday 11 November. If that's right, change "which day before Wednesday" to "today" or "as early as possible", and mention that your practical is at 10am today. If it is still before Wednesday on your side, send it as it is.
